title: AnnouncementUsageResponse
description: Response containing announcement repository storage usage limits and current utilization.

totalFileSizeUsedKB.description: Total file size used by announcements in this repository in kilobytes.

maxAudioFileSizeAllowedKB.description: Maximum audio file size allowed to upload in kilobytes.

maxVideoFileSizeAllowedKB.description: Maximum video file size allowed to upload in kilobytes.

totalFileSizeLimitMB.description: Total file size limit for the repository in megabytes.
